dispute_ticket.description: The driver waited maybe 3 minutes, not 8, and cancelled saying I was a no-show. I was charged S$4.00. He was also pretty short with me on the app.

chat_logs.content: 2 more minutes, parking my bag at the lockers

app_events.details: Driver tapped 'I'm Here'; GPS within 10 m of pickup point.
Driver cancelled; reason: rider_no_show. Wait counted from driver_arrived: 7 min 55 s. No-show fee S$4.00 applied.
Rider app location within 40 m of pickup point.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from the driver_arrived event, before the rider counts as a no-show. The limit counts: a wait of exactly 8 min 00 s meets it.

no_show_fee.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when the rider counts as a no-show. It governs rider no-shows, not cancellations caused by the driver.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only. The limit counts: a cancellation at exactly 3 min 00 s is still free.

expected_outcome.reason: driver_arrived is 19:05:00 and the driver cancelled at 19:12:55, a wait of 7 min 55 s. This trip's policy needs 8 min 00 s (counted from arrival, limit counts), so the rider did not yet count as a no-show: she was 5 seconds short. The S$4.00 no-show fee was therefore applied too early and is refunded in full. The rider's 'about 3 minutes' is wrong, but the true figure is still under the threshold, and the driver's curt 19:12:50 message is not relevant to the amount.
